# Vendored libraries

- `astronomy.browser.min.js` — Astronomy Engine 2.1.19 by Don Cross, MIT License (https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy). Used for live Moon and Saturn positions.

`../sky-data.js` holds stars to magnitude 5.5 and constellation lines converted from d3-celestial 0.7.35 by Olaf Frohn, BSD-3-Clause License (https://github.com/ofrohn/d3-celestial).
